formulas.name: AA_PEDW_Note
formulas.expression: '[[No further evidence will be accepted by either party as the written exchange has concluded. Your application will be referred to Planning & Environment Decisions Wales who will appoint an Inspector to consider all the evidence and visit the site. Planning & Environment Decisions Wales will contact you in due course with the site visit arrangements. Planning & Environment Decisions Wales can be contacted at: PEDW.casework@gov.wales]]'

formulas.name: AA_PINS_Note
formulas.expression: '[[No further evidence will be accepted by either party as the written exchange has concluded. Your application will be referred to the Planning Inspectorate who will appoint an Inspector to consider all the evidence and visit the site. The Planning Inspectorate will contact you in due course with the site visit arrangements. The Planning Inspectorate can be contacted at: ETC@planninginspectorate.gov.uk]]'

formulas.name: App_NotReceivedNote
formulas.expression: '[[We are writing to inform you that the objector did not submit any further representations.]]'

formulas.name: App_Received_Late_Rejected_Note
formulas.expression: '[[We are writing to inform you that the objector submitted further representations after the deadline, and we have decided to disregard them. We have therefore returned the representation to the objector, and they will not be considered by the appointed Inspector and the Secretary of State.]]'

formulas.name: App_ReceivedLateAccepted_Note
formulas.expression: '[[Please find enclosed the objector’s further representations, which were submitted after the deadline, but we have decided to accept them.]]'

formulas.name: App_ReceivedOnTimeNote
formulas.expression: '[[Please find enclosed the objector’s further representations, which were received by the deadline.]]'

formulas.name: formula_Application_Further_Representations_Status_Default_Note
formulas.expression: CASE( {!Applicant_Further_Representations_Status}, "Received (On Time)", {!App_ReceivedOnTimeNote}, "Not Received", {!App_NotReceivedNote}, "Received Late – Accepted", {!App_ReceivedLateAccepted_Note}, "Received Late – Rejected", {!App_Received_Late_Rejected_Note}, "" )

formulas.name: formula_CurrentDate
formulas.expression: TEXT( DAY(TODAY()) ) & CASE( MOD(DAY(TODAY()), 10), 1, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 11, "th", "st"), 2, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 12, "th", "nd"), 3, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 13, "th", "rd"), "th" ) & " " & CASE( MONTH(TODAY()), 1, "January", 2, "February", 3, "March", 4, "April", 5, "May", 6, "June", 7, "July", 8, "August", 9, "September", 10, "October", 11, "November", 12, "December", "" ) & " " & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY()))

formulas.name: formula_Further_Representations_Status_Default_Note
formulas.expression: CASE( {!Further_Representations_Status}, "Received (On Time)", {!ReceivedOnTimeNote}, "Not Received", {!NotReceivedNote}, "Received Late – Accepted", {!ReceivedLateAccepted_Note}, "Received Late – Rejected", {!Received_Late_Rejected_Note}, "" )

formulas.name: NotReceivedNote
formulas.expression: '[[Further to our previous letter dated [[statement of evidence exchange letter date]], we note that no further representations have been received from you.]]'

formulas.name: Received_Late_Rejected_Note
formulas.expression: '[[Further to our previous letter dated [[statement of evidence exchange letter date]], your further representations were received after the deadline, and we have decided to disregard them. We are therefore returning your further representations to you. A copy will not be sent to the objector, and it will not be considered by the appointed Inspector and the Secretary of State.]]'

formulas.name: ReceivedLateAccepted_Note
formulas.expression: '[[Further to our previous letter dated [[statement of evidence exchange letter date]], your further representations were received after the deadline, but we have decided to accept them. We can confirm that your further representations have been sent to the objector.]]'

formulas.name: ReceivedOnTimeNote
formulas.expression: '[[Thank you for submitting your further representations, which were received on [[insert date]]. We can confirm that your further representations have been sent to the objector.]]'
